usage: jbus home [-h] [--directory] [--keep DIRECTORY] [brief]

positional arguments:
  brief             the brief or the request, <state>/tasks/<slug>.md

options:
  -h, --help        show this help message and exit
  --directory       print the home's directory, not its thread
  --keep DIRECTORY  read lines of <brief>\t<text> and print the text of those
                    whose home is DIRECTORY
